Title: Ireland – Medical hospital services – Multi-Party Framework Agreement for the Provision of a Non-Operative Treatment Pathway for Low Complexity Spinal Patients
Procedure title: Multi-Party Framework Agreement for the Provision of a Non-Operative Treatment Pathway for Low Complexity Spinal Patients
Description: The Contracting Authority intends to establish a framework agreement with suitably-qualified and experienced medical service providers to deliver end-to-end outpatient assessment, diagnostic and non-operative treatment pathways for a cohort of approximately 1,200 patients. These patients are currently on a neurosurgical waiting list, rather than an orthopaedic list; however, the Contracting Authority will accept tender submissions involving orthopaedic spinal surgeon review. For tenderers’ information, a low-complexity spine patient is defined as an individual with a straightforward, one or two level or localised spinal condition that requires standard surgical or medical management with minimal technical difficulty and lower physiological risk. Under the framework agreement, the successful tenderers will assume responsibility for patients from the first specialist outpatient assessment to the patient’s discharge or until a determination has been made that surgical intervention is clinically indicated. It is a mandatory condition for the operation of this framework agreement that appointed framework operators are eligible to deliver low-complexity spine procedures under the relevant National Surgical Services Framework.

Title: Finland – Advisory and consultative engineering services – Nurmijärven kunnan ulkovalaistuksen isännöintipalvelu
Procedure title: Nurmijärven kunnan ulkovalaistuksen isännöintipalvelu
Description: Nurmijärven kunta pyytää tarjouksia ulkovalaistuksen isännöintipalvelusta. Hankinnan kohteena oleva ulkovalaistusverkko käsittää Nurmijärven kunnan hallinnoiman ulkovalaistusverkon, jonka laajuus on noin 14 000 valopistettä. Palvelusopimus on sopijaosapuolten, tilaajan ja isännöintipalvelun tuottajan, kesken solmittu sopimus, jossa tuottaja suorittaa sopimusasiakirjoissa määritellyn palvelun kokonaisvaltaisesti. Palvelun tarkempi sisältö ja tehtävät sekä palvelulle ja palveluntuottajalle asetetut soveltuvuusvaatimukset on määritelty tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liiteasiakirjoissa. Palvelusopimuksen tehnyt palveluntuottaja sitoutuu tuottamaan palvelut sopimusasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Tuotettavien palveluiden tulee olla laadukkaita ja kustannustehokkaita ja niihin tulee sisältyä luotettava laadunvarmistus. Palvelusopimuskausi on 1.1.2027-31.12.2028, minkä lisäksi sopimukseen sisältyy viiden (5) vuoden optiokausi (1.1.2029-31.12.2033). Sopimuksen jatkamisesta sopimuskauden ajaksi päättää tilaaja.

În cadrul Primăriei Sectorului 3, s-a implementat si dezvoltat un sistem informatic ce facilitează gestionarea materialelor, obiectelor de inventar și mijloacelor fixe utilizate în procesul de mentenanță de către instituțiile subordonate Primăriei, se pot primi direct din platforma de gestiune a mentenanței necesarul pentru fiecare lucrare de mentenanță planificată, se efectuează intrări, ieșiri în consum, transferuri între gestiuni și rapoarte privind stocurile existente, pe fiecare tip de material, obiect de inventar sau mijloc fix, pe gestiune sau loc de folosință. Obiectivul urmărit: Obiectivul contractului îl reprezintă încheierea unui acord-cadru privind prestarea de servicii de închiriere a sistemelor GPS necesare pentru întreaga flotă auto a Primăriei Sector 3 și a Direcției Generale de Poliție Locală Sector 3. Serviciile de închiriere ce vor fi prestate vor trebui să respecte toate reglementările legale în vigoare. In conformitate cu prevederile art. 160 alin. (1) din Legea 98/2016, termenul limita pana la care orice operator economic interesat de participarea la procedura de achizitie publica are dreptul de a solicita clarificari sau informatii suplimentare in legatura cu documentatia de atribuire este de 18 zile inainte de termenul limita de depunere a ofertelor.
